title: palicourea sulphurea
intro: Palicourea sulphurea, commonly known as the Yellow Cinchona, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its diverse health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antimalarial properties. The therapeutic actions of Palicourea sulphurea include its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, such as palicourene and isopalicourene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
